top10.title: docs/archive/2026-10-01-baseline/implementation/batch2/lark.md
headingPath: 飞书：独立机器人、扫码创建与绑定、可靠通知
top10.excerpt: 状态更新采用 compare-and-set：同一卡片连点、Web与卡片同时批准、approve/reject竞态，最多一次业务效果。stale decision 更新卡片为“资料已变化，需重新查看”，不能批准不同内容。用户修改后执行先生成新 proposal digest，再重新验证，不沿用旧批准。

top10.title: docs/reader-first/publication-lifecycle.md
headingPath: 让文章在材料变化后仍然可用
top10.excerpt: 一次真实维护暴露了这一区别：记忆指南用项目说明的 3–19 行作为文章更新的背景，远处新增验证结果也让它失效；这是把根标题等同于整篇依赖造成的过宽判断。另一处引用与“正在验证”状态写在同一小节，修改状态也牵连引用。前者由通用结构比较修正；后者把实验状态移到独立验证章节、把事实/待办说明独立分节，并让模型按新结构重新核对

top10.title: docs/reader-first/assistant-memory-flow.md
headingPath: 个人约定如何变成可查询、能跟进的记忆

top10.title: docs/reader-first/retrieval-redesign.md

top10.title: docs/archive/2026-10-01-baseline/prototype/app.jsx

limits: Six known repository regression questions; manual core-evidence coverage does not prove complete or correct generated answers.
Models share one read-only SQLite snapshot, current originals, embedding and production ranking; no private data, downloads or database copies.
Raw cross-encoder input is before tokenizer truncation at 512 tokens; firstInputRank only checks supplied text.
Timing includes loading and exact vector scans; sequential local measurements, not a throughput benchmark.
Old expected-path metric is kept separately and unchanged. Evidence annotations are never passed to retrievers or models.
Default reranker configuration remains unchanged. Native Decision admission can fail; an unavailable model is not an accuracy result.

beforeAdvisoryGuard.limit: Earlier indexed snapshot, not the current frozen matrix; regression triggered advisory-only protection, not threshold tuning.

failures.error: Error: Agent timed out: no activity for 480000 ms

materialConceptAudit.scope: Current repository original text digests and concept line bounds; not semantic review or database state.

advisoryProtection.behavior: Attach assessment.advisoryOnly, preserve original order and all candidates.

firstFullFailure.resolution: Disable optional Decision in fixture setup; 9 focused HTTP cases and final full check passed.
